summary: Korea Electric Power Corp filed a Form 6-K containing a quarterly business report in English summarizing its Korean-language filing with the Financial Services Commission of Korea. The report covers the period January 1 to March 31, 2026, and includes a company overview, financial results by segment, product unit prices, and power purchase data. It states no change in management or major shareholders. This is a routine periodic report with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review.
